Our AI tutor grew a personality.

BloomyBot acts as a scaffolded, Socratic coach for kids. In simple English: it gets progressively more helpful by providing hints and asking questions.

Kids often treat BloomyBot like a real person.

Student: "yes mr bloomybot sir"
BloomyBot: "Ha - just Bloomy works fine! See you soon."
Student: "yes mr bloomy sir"

2 reactions:

1. Since when did BloomyBot decide to rename itself?!
2. Kids are adorable.

That is all.

evidence.title: Honestly, enterprise software isn’t really blocked by the ability to write code.
evidence.text:
Honestly, enterprise software isn’t really blocked by the ability to write code.

From speaking with several IT leaders, we’ve learned the hard part for IT teams is understanding everything the change might affect.

Business logic often lives across many different configs, integrations, approval flows, old tickets, and the people who remember why a system was set up a certain way.

That’s really why even small changes take weeks. 

The interesting problem is not just how to generate the implementation faster. It is how we can best empower an IT engineer to understand the surrounding system well enough to make the change safely. 

At Assemble, we’ve been exploring the right graphical UX to help engineers review and approve large changes with confidence. Reach out to founders@assemble.ai to learn more.

evidence.title: We got a crazy day today at Nex.ai (WUPHF).
evidence.text:
We got a crazy day today at Nex.ai (WUPHF). We're launching on Product Hunt! https://lnkd.in/ebWzTmN9

Wuphf lets you run a team of agents, each with their own personalities and skills, to accomplish whatever tasks you set them to. We focused on tooling for an actionable company but it could be anything, a group of friends, a new D&D group, trip planners, it's up to your imagination.

The project is open source and we built in support for local LLMs so you can use the compute you already have and keep your musings 100% private. 

If you have thoughts, want help setting it up or are just excited, let me know. I'm happy to help out :) 


On a personal note - I'm a bit nervous, it's an especially competitive day with much 3 much bigger companies launching products at the same time. Lets gooo!
